tasks.short: Verify names, numbers, and computations on the form.

steps.what: Check that the taxpayer identification number matches the register.
Verify computations against the supporting documentation.

loop.purpose: Read a figure from the support only when it matches the return line.
loop.check: The figure equals the return line and the line ids match.
loop.stop: A figure that does not match is left out.
loop.why_not_simpler: The support is a document, not a typed amount. A template cannot read the figure off it. The loop stops on a mismatch, and the agent reviews that line.

steps.what: Review amounts that do not match the form.

tasks.design: Names and taxpayer identification numbers are checked in the {ERP} against the register when both are stored. Computations are verified against the supporting documentation, and a figure that does not match the form stops. The revenue agent reviews the amounts that do not tie. The check does not change a figure.
tasks.previous_blocker: Computations were ticked on paper, and a support figure from another year was accepted.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored number can be checked, and a support figure can be read when it ties.
tasks.still_hard: A support document that does not tie, and a name that matches the wrong person.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a tied total on a document that is not this taxpayer’s.
tasks.altitude: Matching numbers are checked. The agent still reviews every amount that does not tie. A mismatch is not corrected by the check.

reach.task: Stop a total that does not tie to its source.
reach.learn: The tie-out can run. The mismatch stays with the agent.

evidence.claim: DataSnipper pulls figures from support into a check, and the team reviews and signs off. It is for verifying totals.
Baker Tilly Netherlands used that check on statement tie-out and test of details, and a person still signed the work.
A recomputed total that does not tie to the source figures stops. The agent reviews the mismatch. The check does not change the figure.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Taxpayer id, line id, and support figure, produced by the form and the support. A line with no support figure is not passed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the register and the return store the office already keeps.
unknowns: Who signs off a tie-out besides the agent.
research_questions: What share of lines have a support figure that ties?
Which mismatches are always reviewed by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still reviews amounts that do not match.

incremental.description: The agent obtains a support figure the file did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the identity check and the figures that already tie to the support. It disappears when a figure does not match and the agent reviews that line. The check does not change the amount. The range is not taken from a vendor time claim.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Resolve delinquent tax from the assets and liabilities.

steps.what: List the tax assets and liabilities on the case.
Examine the delinquent problem and determine a resolution.
Record the resolution the agent accepts.

tasks.design: Tax assets and liabilities already stored are listed in the {ERP}. The revenue agent examines them and determines the resolution of the delinquent problem. A case with no balance id is not listed. The list does not resolve the debt.
tasks.previous_blocker: Assets were taken from an old statement and the resolution was written against that picture.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored balances can be listed before the agent examines the case.
tasks.still_hard: An asset the list does not show, and a resolution the balances do not justify.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a complete list that still points at the wrong resolution.
tasks.altitude: The stored balances are on the case. The agent still examines them and still determines the resolution. A missing balance is not treated as zero.

reach.task: Read a balance list and still decide what the person should do.
reach.learn: The list can be prepared. The resolution stays here.

evidence.claim: Stored assets and liabilities can be listed. The list cannot determine how a delinquent tax problem is resolved.
The resolution stays with the agent. A balance list is not a settlement.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Case id and balance id, produced by the ledger. A case with no balance id is not listed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the ledger the office already keeps.
unknowns: Which assets are in the tax picture.
Who accepts a resolution besides the agent.
research_questions: What share of cases have stored balances?

already_counted.description: The agent still examines the case and determines the resolution.
The agent still records the resolution.

incremental.description: The agent adds an asset the list did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is the list of balances already stored. It disappears when a balance id is missing and the agent rebuilds the picture. Determining the resolution stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Impose deadlines and monitor the payments.

steps.what: List delinquent payments against the stored deadline.
Impose the payment deadline on the delinquent taxpayer.
Monitor whether the payments meet that deadline.

tasks.design: Payments already stored are listed in the {ERP} against the deadline already stored. The revenue agent imposes the deadline on the delinquent taxpayer and monitors whether it is met. A payment with no date is not listed as late. The list does not impose a deadline.
tasks.previous_blocker: Deadlines were written in a diary and checked only when someone asked.
tasks.enabler_now: A stored payment and a stored deadline can be compared before the agent decides.
tasks.still_hard: A payment that arrived but does not clear the debt, and a deadline that should move.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a date that was met on the ledger and still leaves the case open.
tasks.altitude: Stored dates are visible. The agent still imposes the deadline and still decides whether it was met. A comparison is not an imposition.

reach.task: Compare a stored date with an action and still decide whether the case is closed.
reach.learn: The date can be listed. Imposing the deadline stays here.

evidence.claim: A stored payment can be compared with a stored deadline. The comparison cannot impose the deadline.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, and a determining score counts. The agent accepts the version before a notice or a refund goes out.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.

Fields: Payment id and deadline date, produced by the payment record. A payment with no date is not listed as late. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the payment record the office already keeps.
unknowns: Which payments count as meeting it.
research_questions: What share of payments have a stored date?
Which deadlines are always set by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still imposes the deadline.
The agent still monitors whether it was met.

incremental.description: The agent dates a payment the record did not hold.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is comparing payments and deadlines already stored. It disappears when the date is missing and the agent reconstructs it. Imposing the deadline stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble the legal documents already drafted for service.
Direct service of the subpoena, warrant, or garnishment.
Record which notice of assessment was served.

tasks.design: Legal documents already drafted are assembled in {DOCS} into a service pack. The revenue agent directs service of the subpoena, warrant, notice of assessment, or garnishment. A document with no case id is not packed. The pack does not serve anyone.
tasks.previous_blocker: Papers for service were gathered from several folders on the morning of the visit.
tasks.enabler_now: A drafted document with a case id can be in the pack before the agent leaves.
tasks.still_hard: A person who cannot be found, and a document that should not be served.
tasks.human_edge: The agent can see a complete pack that should not be served today.
tasks.altitude: The pack can be ready. The agent still directs service and still records what was served. A pack is not service.

reach.task: Carry a prepared pack and still serve it in person.
reach.learn: The pack can be assembled. Service stays here.

evidence.claim: Drafted documents with a case id can be assembled into a pack. The pack cannot serve a subpoena, a warrant, or a garnishment.
EU GDPR article 22 bars a solely automated decision with legal effect, and a determining score counts. The agent accepts the version before a notice or a refund goes out.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A revenue agent in a European tax office. National assessment rules apply. A list does not send a notice, issue a refund, or seize property.
Fields: Case id and document id, produced by the draft. A document with no case id is not packed. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the revenue agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: Use the document store the office already keeps.
research_questions: What share of documents already have a case id?
Which service is always done by the agent?

already_counted.description: The agent still records what was served.

incremental.description: The agent replaces a document the pack got wrong.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving is assembling documents already drafted. It disappears when the case id is missing and the agent gathers the papers. Directing service stays with the agent.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent still reviews a figure that does not tie, still resolves a delinquent case, and still serves the legal document. A name check and a stored deadline can be ready before that work.
reach: Financial quantitative analysts stop a total that does not tie to its source, and this job learns the same stop on a tax computation.
Government property inspectors serve a document in person, and this job learns a pack is not service.
skills_to_grow: Stop a computation that does not match the support.
Keep service of a subpoena or a garnishment with the agent.
role.ambitious_version: Name checks and tied totals are ready before the agent reviews the exceptions, and service of legal documents is still done by that person.
